doc: The function called WITHOUT its lacunarity argument: the Python default 2.03 (the value every caller relies on). 19 rows (frequency, max_frequency): for k = 2, 5, 10, 20, 40 one row 0.1% above 2.03^(k - 1) and one 0.1% below 2.03^k (frequency 1), so the count is k and any default off by 0.05% or more (2.029 and 2.031 are tried) changes at least 4 rows; plus production-like rows (48 .. 163 and 326, 3 .. 24, 0.5 .. 1000), frequency just above and just below the maximum (5 against 5.005 and 4.995: n = 1 either way, the second from the clamp of 0 to 1), frequency above the maximum and a very low frequency. Every row is at least 5e-4 (relative) from a boundary 2.03^j * frequency (checked at build time). Integer output: exact.
